copy.curiosityHook: Can an ambitious young guitarist actually track down a lost piece of musical history, or will the legendary song remain out of reach?
copy.description: Directed by Walter Hill, this musical drama follows an aspiring blues guitar virtuoso on a determined search to uncover a legendary, long-lost song attributed to the iconic musician Robert Johnson.
copy.vibeSummary: A steady, thoughtful drama with an engaging musical pulse, balancing mystery, romance, and moderate emotional weight.
copy.whyWatch: It weaves blues mythology, drama, and romance into a distinct mystery driven by artistic obsession and the timeless lore of Robert Johnson.
